review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.statement: Velt's comment options-dropdown-content exposes NO CopyLink slot (slots: Assign/MakePrivate/Edit/Delete(.Comment/.Thread)/Notification/MarkAsRead). CopyLink is a separate dialog-level slot (velt-comment-dialog-copy-link-wireframe), not an options-menu item — a design 'Copy link' options-menu row is mode_blocked in strictly wireframe.

Velt renders BOTH the resolve and unresolve button slots on every comment card (unresolve-button-internal is present even on unresolved cards). Do not detect the resolved state via :has(unresolve-internal) — it matches all cards.
learnings.evidence: live probe: unresContent=14, matchesHasUnresolve=true on unresolved cards

learnings.statement: MinimalFilterDropdown content rows render inside app-comment-sidebar-minimal-filter-dropdown-content-<slot> wrappers (app- prefix), and the live open filter menu renders in the sidebar tree (NOT a cdk-overlay). Key filter selectors on '.hw-rail app-comment-sidebar-minimal-filter-dropdown-content-<slot>' to avoid the 0-size registry twin.

delta-compare resolves the FIRST querySelector match for a surface/element — which is the 0-size wireframe registry twin for wireframe/overlay surfaces (content-height 0px, elements 'missing'). Pin surfaceSelector + element selectors to live-only classes (.velt-comment-dialog--sidebar-mode, .hw-rail .vc-filter-menu) so measurement hits the visible clone.
learnings.evidence: filter block measured 0px/27-missing on '.vc-filter-menu' twin; clean on '.hw-rail .vc-filter-menu'
